job: Read a few headline numbers at a glance, as one joined strip.
purpose: A row of figures joined into one bordered group and divided by hairlines. Each tile is an eyebrow, a figure and a muted line; add a delta, a meter or sparkline, a unit or a quiet action. The delta tone is the meaning, not the direction. Tiles wrap on their own; data-variant="cards" makes each tile its own card.
useWhen: The top of a page shows three to six numbers: credits, requests, success rate.
A billing summary pairs a figure with a meter and a link.
A metric needs a change against last week, with the right tone.

avoidWhen.when: One figure with detail behind a click.
Many records with the same fields.
A figure that is use against a limit, on its own.

variants.useWhen: Each figure is its own bordered card.
One tile becomes its own card.
The change is good, whichever way it went: latency down is success.

parts.role: A figure with its unit on one baseline.
The unit or period, small and quiet.
A muted line under the figure.
A meter or sparkline inside the tile.
